title: Puppy Yoga + Cuddles at Stoney's Benefitting a Local Austin Rescue
description: 45 minutes of outdoor puppy yoga in Stoney's Good Time Ranch, followed by an open puppy cuddle hour. Net proceeds go to a local rescue.
long_description:
45 minutes of outdoor puppy yoga in Stoney's Good Time Ranch, followed by an open puppy cuddle hour. Net proceeds go to a local rescue.

About this Event

Puppy yoga, East Austin style — in a backyard built for it.

Join Kitten Paws and Downward Dogs at Stoney's Good Time Ranch for 45 minutes of gentle, all-levels yoga in their fully fenced, shaded backyard, with adoptable rescue puppies loose among the mats. Fans and misters running, coffee and matcha pop-up open, and no one minding if a puppy interrupts your flow.

Then the puppies stay. When class ends, the yard opens for a full hour of puppy cuddles and photos — no ticket needed for that part. Bring a friend who'd rather skip the yoga, grab a coffee, and hang out with the pups. Donations to the rescue are gladly accepted.

The puppies are the point. Every puppy is a rescue and is looking for a home. Our rescue partner brings the puppies, their pen and their volunteers, so you can meet, cuddle and start an adoption conversation on the spot.

Where the money goes. Proceeds from this event go to a local Austin rescue. We will announce our rescue partner here as soon as they are confirmed, and the event is held in their honour with the net proceeds going straight to them.

THE DAY
• Sunday, October 18, 2026 · event window 1:00–3:00 PM
• Yoga 1:00–1:45 PM · open puppy cuddles 1:45–2:45 PM
• Stoney's Good Time Ranch · 3526 E 7th St, Austin, TX 78702
• Fully fenced, shaded backyard with fans and misters
• All levels welcome · bring your own mat
• 30 yoga spots · cuddle hour is free and donation-based
• Ages 21+ only
• Wear something you don't mind a puppy paw on; it's outdoors, so dress for the weather

GOOD TO KNOW
• Yoga tickets are limited to 30. When it's sold out, it's sold out — but the cuddle hour is open to everyone.
• Tickets are non-refundable but fully transferable.
• Real puppies, real backyard: expect a little chaos and a lot of joy. The rescue's volunteers handle everything the puppies do.
